clips.title: The story
paras: Songblade Search is a dwarven errand in which Dorin Songblade asks travelers to check on his brother Daewyn in the Wetlands. Daewyn set off with an archaeological crew from Loch Modan to dig in unexplored hills, but his uncharacteristic silence left his brother fearing the worst.

Dorin Songblade remained behind at his workshop, inundated with orders to refit girdles, while his brother Daewyn joined a dwarven excavation crew setting out from Loch Modan. Daewyn ventured north into the rugged hills of the Wetlands, eager to explore virgin ground untouched by dwarven pickaxes. However, Daewyn customarily sends letters immediately after arriving, and his silence left Dorin deeply unsettled.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.
Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.
Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.
If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
